prose: Bloomberg reports Anthropic's draft S-1 shows it spent about $9 billion on compute and infrastructure in the first half of 2026, up from $2.3 billion a year earlier, and that it could spend $750 billion in the coming years. The article could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline figures.
highlights: Draft S-1: ~$9B spent on compute and infrastructure in H1 2026
Up from $2.3B in the same period a year earlier
Could spend $750B on compute in the coming years
Source: David Morris, Bloomberg, via Techmeme
basis: Basis: Techmeme headline only; the Bloomberg article fetch returned an error.
